summary: Verstappen hunts his third consecutive Monza victory as McLaren's resurgent pace threatens to reclaim ground in the title fight. Norris and Piastri circle the Red Bull, ready to exploit any strategic vulnerability on Monza's high-speed straights where DRS battles will define the outcome. A McLaren one-two could slice deep into Verstappen's championship lead, while a dominant Red Bull result would reassert control heading into the sport's final third.
